scripts.typecheck: for step in steps/*/; do [ -n "$(find "$step/fronds" -name '*.ts')" ] || continue; tsc -p "$step/fronds" || exit 1; done

scripts.dev: cd consumer && pnpm exec nuxt dev --port 3002

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p catalog/fronds && tsc -p shipping/fronds && tsc -p shop/fronds

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node scripts/scan.ts && tsc && chmod +x dist/src/bin.js
